blocks.en: Games we designed to make synthetic biology fun, accessible, and memorable.
blocks.text: Games we designed to make synthetic biology fun, accessible, and memorable.
blocks.zh: 我們設計這些遊戲，讓合成生物學變得好玩、好親近，也更容易記住。

blocks.en: Protect engineered crops from climate stress using targeted biological protectants.
blocks.text: Protect engineered crops from climate stress using targeted biological protectants.
blocks.zh: 以專一的生物保護劑保護工程改造的作物，抵禦氣候逆境。

blocks.en: The world's first online educational game about textile recycling!
blocks.text: The world's first online educational game about textile recycling!
blocks.zh: 全世界第一款以紡織品回收為主題的線上教育遊戲！

blocks.en: A game that illustrates the concept of enzyme specificity and our previous year's project on degrading PET plastic.
blocks.text: A game that illustrates the concept of enzyme specificity and our previous year's project on degrading PET plastic.
blocks.zh: 透過此遊戲介紹酵素專一性概念，以及我們去年分解 PET 塑膠的專案。

blocks.en: A clicker game that explores the connection between sustainability, and finance.
blocks.text: A clicker game that explores the connection between sustainability, and finance.
blocks.zh: 一款點擊遊戲，探索永續與金融之間的關聯。
